notes: B-56 regression (fixed 2026-10-29). Twinblade Assassins: 'At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died this turn, draw a card.' Mana abilities are no menu rows (2026-11-11): the payer sacrifices a Treasure while a cost is paid, choosing its colour (CR 605.3a), so the pack casts with "tap": true. The Treasure pays Shock's {R} (2 to the opponent), so only a Treasure, a noncreature, goes to the graveyard this turn -> NO draw: the hand keeps its one card. Before the fix DIED_THIS_TURN counted every battlefield-to-graveyard dies row and the trigger drew. A sacrificed Treasure is a token that left the battlefield, so it ceases to exist (CR 704.5d): its zone is 'ceased'.
